releaseNotes:
Feature: Codex CLI agent engine beside Cursor (Settings + Telegram /engine)
Feature: Codex providers — OpenRouter, Ollama (local free), LM Studio, OpenAI
Feature: Codex Install / Update CLI / Test connection + setup guide
Feature: Auto-update Codex CLI about every 24 hours
Feature: Telegram Deploy Preview before deploy
Feature: Quiet progress option now applies to Cursor and Codex
Fix: Codex Persian/UTF-8 prompts via stdin
Fix: Codex config.toml no longer duplicates provider keys
Fix: Codex resume no longer fails on invalid --sandbox args
Fix: Codex can edit project files (sandbox trust bypass)
Fix: Clearer provider 429 rate-limit errors
Fix: Git rename paths handled in change list / deploy preview
Fix: Workspace rules also pick up AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
